sourceAndOwner.exactSentence: The resulting training becomes more rounded rather than one-dimensional.
sourceAndOwner.sourceMeaning: Developing several abilities rather than only one; a shape metaphor.
sourceAndOwner.rationale: The source compares multi-ability training with one-dimensional training; selected owner313 already teaches balanced development across abilities, without demanding equal excellence. The comparative rounded form is a grammatical variant of that owner, not a new learner decision.

externalLexicalEvidence.title: Collins rounded
externalLexicalEvidence.relevance: Includes diversified, well-developed person or education sense.

externalLexicalEvidence.title: Cambridge well-rounded
externalLexicalEvidence.relevance: Defines breadth of ideas or activities.

findings.issue: The new keyed comparative “becoming a more rounded learner” would be better grounded by an explicit earlier maths-only baseline. The prompt says only 一位同學 while all English options assign she/her. Foil C claims club membership, which the prompt never establishes, so it can be discarded without assessing the roundedness distinction.
findings.repair: Specify a female learner who previously focused mainly on mathematics and now demonstrably develops hosting, teamwork and sport. Make C overclaim equal skill from the stated practice rather than introduce club membership. Preserve option IDs and key b.

findings.issue: The revised register identifies an education/development context but omits a likely speaker/listener pair required by Golden SOP P81.
findings.repair: Name a plausible course adviser or teacher addressing a learner/parent/colleague, while retaining the natural British comparative qualification.

nonblockingNotes: The exact source comparative is less common than well-rounded but the source and Collins rounded definition support it. The target deliberately limits more rounded to a narrow set of educational/person-development continuations; other grammatical collocations are outside this proposal.
The inherited dialogue option was made target-bearing and remains a faithful EN/ZH clarification.
